issues.explanation: 鳴こう is the volitional form “will/let’s meow”; the meaning “try to meow” comes from とする.
Here て is the conjunctive particle in としても, not an auxiliary.
issues.suggested_fix: Set type to "particle" and meaning_en to "conjunctive linker".

issues.explanation: The segment itself means “decrease”; “become hungry” is the idiomatic meaning of 腹が減る.
The overlay label Nなく is not a valid analysis of 仕方なく; なく is the adverbial form of ない after the noun 仕方, in the fixed expression meaning “with no choice.”
issues.suggested_fix: Remove this overlay or label it as the fixed expression 仕方なく, meaning "with no choice; reluctantly".

issues.explanation: The attributive form is そうな as a single inflected form of the auxiliary そうだ; splitting な as a separate copula form misanalyzes the morphology.
issues.suggested_fix: Use segment "そうな" with lemma "そうだ", kana "そうな", and meaning "seems likely to exist".

issues.explanation: The overlay offsets 93–98 do not cover あったので; they cover text beginning with に. The correct zero-based range is 97–102.
issues.suggested_fix: Set start to 97 and end to 102.

issues.explanation: The overlay offsets 119–123 do not cover なければ. The correct zero-based range is 125–129.
issues.suggested_fix: Set start to 125 and end to 129.

issues.explanation: In 餓死する, 餓死 denotes dying of starvation or starvation death, not merely “starvation.”
issues.suggested_fix: Use meaning_en "death from starvation; starve to death".

issues.explanation: This is the conjunctive form し of the auxiliary verb する in the compound 餓死する, not an independent word.
issues.suggested_fix: Set type to "auxiliary", lemma "する", and meaning_en "do; die from, in 餓死する".

issues.explanation: かもしれない is a genuine fixed modal expression meaning “might; may”; the current split obscures that fixed construction and gives か, も, and しれ misleading standalone meanings.
issues.suggested_fix: Group as one auxiliary expression with lemma "かもしれない", kana "かもしれない", meaning "might; may".

issues.segment_text: 餓死していたかもしれない
issues.explanation: The overlay offsets 131–143 do not cover the stated surface. The correct zero-based range for 餓死していたかもしれない is 137–149.
issues.suggested_fix: Set start to 137 and end to 149.

issues.explanation: で does not independently mean “even” here, and も does not mean “also”; together でも means “even now; still.”
issues.suggested_fix: Group でも as a particle with meaning "even; still", or explain で and も as the combined focus construction.

issues.explanation: The overlay offsets 165–170 do not cover 通っている. The correct zero-based range is 172–177.
issues.suggested_fix: Set start to 172 and end to 177.

issues.explanation: ものの is a fixed concessive conjunction meaning “although; despite”; treating もの as an ordinary noun with meaning “although” is inaccurate.
issues.suggested_fix: Group ものの as a conjunction with lemma "ものの", kana "ものの", meaning "although; despite".

issues.explanation: The overlay offsets 176–182 do not cover 入ったものの. The correct zero-based range is 183–189.
issues.suggested_fix: Set start to 183 and end to 189.

issues.explanation: The overlay offsets 190–195 cover どうしてよい, not 分からない. The correct zero-based range is 197–202.
issues.suggested_fix: Set start to 197 and end to 202.

issues.explanation: The overlay offsets 209–214 cover part of 寒くなり, not 降ってきた. The correct zero-based range is 217–222.
issues.suggested_fix: Set start to 217 and end to 222.
